item.title: Ask to Borrow an Empty Plant Pot
item.prompt_text: You are helping a child grow beans for school. You need an empty pot about as wide as a dinner plate. Ask Eli if you can borrow one until Friday and explain how you will return it. Say what you will do if Eli has only a much smaller pot.
item.target_grammar: Could I for a request, as wide as for size, and if for an alternative.
item.target_structure: Give the purpose and size, name the return plan, and end with a fallback.

checklist.point: Explain why you need a pot.
Say what you will do if the pot is too small.
